summary: Global Cord Blood Corp, under Cayman Islands court-appointed joint provisional liquidators, furnished its seventeenth report to the Grand Court. The filing announces the September 1, 2026 report availability, continuing ongoing insolvency proceedings initiated September 22, 2022. The JPLs remain in control, with the report accessible on company and creditor-update websites. This is a routine periodic update in a court-supervised restructuring/liquidation process. What to watch: developments regarding asset realization or creditor distributions in subsequent reports.
